title: [29.X]-Inconsistent Validation of Non-Deductible VAT % for Purchase Lines Sharing the Same VAT Identifier
summary: Non-deductible VAT % validation in the Non-Ded. VAT Impl. codeunit is now applied the same way to every purchase line that shares a VAT identifier. Two lines were removed from the implementation, and tests were updated in several country layers.
key_points: Fixes inconsistent Non-Deductible VAT % validation for purchase lines sharing the same VAT identifier
Two lines removed from codeunit 6201 Non-Ded. VAT Impl.
New unit tests in W1 NonDeductibleUT and CZ purchase posting tests
Existing non-deductible VAT tests adjusted in W1, AU, IT and RU layers
